title: Front Page Catering and Cherry Bim Pty Limited - proposed merger

body_sections.Summary: Front Page Catering and Cherry Bim Pty Ltd - proposed merger
body_sections.Market definition: The supply of kosher catering services in Sydney by caterers approved by Kashrut Authority
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed merger was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market because barriers to entry (primarily the need for Kashrut Authority approval and customer loyalty to existing caterers) were reasonably low. In addition, there is a real question as to whether the market is a  substantial market pursuant to section 50(6) of the Trade Practices Act 1974.
